Add a threshold-driven auto-invoke so large tasks fan out without an explicit operator call. Surfaced by the 2026-06-03 utilization assessment as the single biggest reason the orchestrator sits at ~28% used.
units.exit_criteria: auto-trigger path + tests asserting fan-out fires at threshold and not below

Add a confidence-gated auto-trigger so low-confidence reasoning escalates to the 5-voice panel automatically. Coordinate model-tier with the LOCAL-LLM blueprint TIER 3.1 (deepseek-r1:14b / qwen3-next:80b voices) — that model-string bump is golf/india's lane.
